title: Character illustrations
slide_intent: Introduce drawn people as a way to depict a specific human interaction when a suitable photograph is unavailable. The gesture needs to remain legible at a glance.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can keep a human focus across publications and campaigns through a recurring, adaptable character style.
demonstration: Two simplified figures embrace on a green field. A few blue strokes emphasize the gesture, and the lower headline picks up the same blue.
practical_value: Select or compose a character scene around the action the reader needs to understand; size it so the figures and gesture lead.

content_islands.name: Purpose note
content_islands.spec: Place the character introduction in the narrow white column beside the rail.

content_islands.name: Character-led composition
content_islands.spec: Let the embracing figures fill the green panel. Keep the silhouettes simple, add a few emphasis strokes and place the headline at lower right.
